newsitem.title: USA: Brent trades shade firmer in late U.S. activity.
newsitem.headline: Brent trades shade firmer in late U.S. activity.

text.p: North Sea Brent trade in the U.S. shaded firmer in a slew of partial outright deals, according to foreign crude players Wednesday.
In the aftermarket window, June Brent was confirmed sold for 300 lots in three separate deals at $18.16 a barrel, 3 cents higher than the IPE settlement at $18.13.
Other trades saw 200 lots sell at $18.17 in June and again for 100 lots at $18.15.
A full cargo of August paper Brent moved at $18.34, steady with the IPE settlement price.
Traders said June/July inter-month spreads sold at both minus 10 and 11 cents, steady from earlier talk.
